sentences.text: Demetria Devonne Lovato -LRB- -LSB- ˈdɛmi_loʊ-ˈvɑːtoʊ -RSB- or ; born August 20 , 1992 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter , and actress .

After making her debut as a child actress in Barney & Friends , Lovato rose to prominence in 2008 when she starred in the Disney Channel television film Camp Rock and released her debut single `` This Is Me '' which peaked at number nine on the Billboard Hot 100 .	Barney & Friends	Barney & Friends	Disney Channel	Disney Channel	Camp Rock	Camp Rock	This Is Me	This Is Me (Demi Lovato song)	television film	television film	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)
The success of the film and its soundtrack resulted in a recording contract with Hollywood Records .	Hollywood	Hollywood Records	Hollywood Records	Hollywood Records	soundtrack	soundtrack
Her debut album , Do n't Forget -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , debuted at number two on the US Billboard 200 .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

The following year , Lovato was cast as the titular character of the television series Sonny with a Chance and she released her sophomore album , Here We Go Again , which became her first one to top the Billboard 200 chart .	television series	television series	Sonny with a Chance	Sonny with a Chance	Here We Go Again	Here We Go Again (Demi Lovato album)	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

After the release of additional television films and their soundtracks in 2010 , including Camp Rock 2 : The Final Jam , Lovato 's personal issues put her career on a hiatus and led to the discontinuation of Sonny with a Chance after a second season .	Camp Rock	Camp Rock	Sonny with a Chance	Sonny with a Chance
She entered a treatment center in November 2010 to seek help for addictions , an eating disorder , and self-harm .
While there , she was diagnosed with bipolar disorder .	bipolar disorder	bipolar disorder
Work on her third studio album , Unbroken -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , began after she successfully completed treatment .	Unbroken	Unbroken (Demi Lovato album)
The album addresses several of her difficulties .

Its lead single , `` Skyscraper '' , became Lovato 's second top 10 entry in the US , while its second single , `` Give Your Heart a Break '' , was certified triple platinum in the country .	Skyscraper	Skyscraper (song)	Give Your Heart a Break	Give Your Heart a Break
Lovato was a judge and mentor on the American version of The X Factor in 2012 and 2013 .	American version	The X Factor (U.S. TV series)	The X Factor	The X Factor
Her third album , Demi -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , opened with first-week sales of 110,000 copies .	Demi	Demi (album)
The lead single from her eponymous album , `` Heart Attack '' , became her third top 10 in the US and the album spawned three more singles .	Heart Attack	Heart Attack (Demi Lovato song)
While promoting the project , Lovato released a book titled Staying Strong : 365 Days a Year -LRB- 2013 -RRB- .
She also returned to acting as a recurring character in Glee , and released a memoir in 2014 .	Glee	Glee (TV series)
Lovato 's fifth album , Confident -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , reached number two on the Billboard 200 .	Confident	Confident (album)	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Its lead single `` Cool for the Summer '' was eventually certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America .	Cool for the Summer	Cool for the Summer	Recording Industry Association of America	Recording Industry Association of America
All five of Lovato 's albums have received a gold certification in the US .	gold	RIAA certification
Musically , Lovato is considered a pop , pop rock , and R&B artist .	pop rock	pop rock	R&B	contemporary R&B	pop	Pop music

Lovato has received a considerable number of accolades , including an MTV Video Music Award , 13 Teen Choice Awards , five People 's Choice Awards , an ALMA Award , a Latin American Music Award and a Grammy Award nomination .	MTV Video Music Award	MTV Video Music Award	Teen Choice Awards	Teen Choice Awards	ALMA Award	ALMA Award	Latin American Music Award	Latin American Music Award	Grammy Award	Grammy Award
In 2013 , Maxim ranked her 26th on its Hot 100 list and Billboard ranked her second on its Social 50 Artists of the Year list .	Maxim	Maxim (magazine)	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Outside the entertainment industry , Lovato has been involved with several social and environmental causes since the launch of her career .	entertainment industry	entertainment industry	social	activism	environmental	environmentalism

In May 2013 , she was cited for her dedication as a mentor to teens and young adults with mental health challenges at a National Children 's Mental Health Awareness Day hosted by the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration in Washington , D.C. .	Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration	Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration
She has also become an advocate for the LGBT community , and women 's rights .	LGBT	LGBT

In 2014 , she was announced as the Grand Marshal for LA Pride week , and that same year she became the face for Human Rights Campaign 's Americans for Marriage Equality Campaign .	LA Pride	LA/Valley Pride	Human Rights Campaign	Human Rights Campaign
In April 2016 , Lovato was honored with the GLAAD Vanguard Award for making a significant difference in promoting equal rights for LGBT people .	LGBT	LGBT	GLAAD Vanguard Award	GLAAD Vanguard Award
